'''Sanza''', also known as '''Krish''', was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] dedicated to casinos, race tracks, arenas, agriculture, and manufacturing. It was the home of the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] species.
